name: typing-animation
title: Typing Animation
description: Types text out character by character, optionally deleting and cycling through words. Screen readers get the full text up front.

props.name: children
props.description: A single string to type. Ignored when words is set.

props.name: words
props.description: Several strings to type one after another.

props.name: deleteSpeed
props.description: Seconds per deleted character. Defaults to half of duration.

props.name: pause
props.description: Seconds to hold a finished word before deleting it.

props.name: loop
props.description: Keep cycling after the last word.

props.name: startOnView
props.description: Wait until the text scrolls into view.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the finished text with no typing.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
